identify.en: Researchers identify several factors that may affect student performance.
identify.zh: 研究人員找出幾個可能影響學生表現的因素。

ignore.en: Do not ignore small errors when checking your final report.
ignore.zh: 檢查最後報告時，不要忽略小錯誤。

illustrate.en: The chart helps illustrate how the population changed over time.
illustrate.zh: 這張圖表有助於說明人口如何隨時間變化。

immediate.en: The school took immediate action after the water pipe broke.
immediate.zh: 水管破裂後，學校立刻採取行動。

impact.en: Regular exercise can have a positive impact on concentration.
impact.zh: 規律運動可以對專注力產生正面影響。

implement.en: The committee plans to implement the new policy next semester.
implement.zh: 委員會計畫下學期實施新政策。

imply.en: The results may imply that sleep affects learning efficiency.
imply.zh: 這些結果可能暗示睡眠會影響學習效率。

impress.en: Her clear explanation managed to impress the entire class.
impress.zh: 她清楚的解釋讓全班留下深刻印象。

improve.en: Daily reading can improve both vocabulary and reading speed.
improve.zh: 每天閱讀可以提升字彙量與閱讀速度。

incident.en: The school reviewed the incident before changing its safety rules.
incident.zh: 學校在修改安全規定前檢討了這起事件。

include.en: The final report should include at least two reliable sources.
include.zh: 最後報告應至少包含兩個可靠來源。

income.en: The survey compares household income across different regions.
income.zh: 這份調查比較不同地區的家庭收入。

increase.en: Better lighting can increase comfort in the study area.
increase.zh: 更好的照明可以提升讀書區的舒適度。

independent.en: Students completed an independent research project during the semester.
independent.zh: 學生在學期中完成一項獨立研究專題。

indicate.en: The red marks indicate which answers need to be corrected.
indicate.zh: 紅色記號指出哪些答案需要修正。

individual.en: Each individual must submit a separate copy of the worksheet.
individual.zh: 每個人都必須各自繳交一份學習單。

industry.en: The local industry has changed greatly because of new technology.
industry.zh: 當地產業因新科技而有很大改變。

influence.en: Friends can influence the way teenagers choose their hobbies.
influence.zh: 朋友可能影響青少年選擇興趣的方式。

inform.en: Please inform the teacher if you cannot attend the meeting.
inform.zh: 如果你無法參加會議，請通知老師。

information.en: Reliable information is important when making a research conclusion.
information.zh: 做研究結論時，可靠資訊非常重要。

initial.en: The initial plan was revised after the team received feedback.
initial.zh: 團隊收到回饋後修改了原先的計畫。

initiative.en: The recycling initiative encouraged students to reduce plastic waste.
initiative.zh: 這項回收倡議鼓勵學生減少塑膠垃圾。

innovation.en: Innovation in technology often changes how people study and work.
innovation.zh: 科技創新經常改變人們學習與工作的方式。

inspire.en: A good teacher can inspire students to explore new ideas.
inspire.zh: 好老師能啟發學生探索新的想法。

install.en: Workers will install new lights in the library this weekend.
install.zh: 工人這個週末會在圖書館安裝新燈具。

instance.en: For instance, public transportation can reduce traffic in cities.
instance.zh: 例如，大眾運輸可以減少城市交通流量。

institution.en: The institution provides scholarships for students with strong academic records.
institution.zh: 該機構為學業表現優秀的學生提供獎學金。

instruction.en: Read each instruction carefully before starting the experiment.
instruction.zh: 開始實驗前請仔細閱讀每一項指示。

intelligent.en: The system uses intelligent software to organize large amounts of data.
intelligent.zh: 這套系統使用智慧軟體整理大量資料。

intend.en: We intend to finish the project before the end of May.
intend.zh: 我們打算在五月底前完成專題。

intense.en: The intense discussion continued until the class period ended.
intense.zh: 激烈的討論一直持續到下課。

interact.en: Students interact with classmates while completing the group activity.
interact.zh: 學生在完成小組活動時會與同學互動。

internal.en: The report explains several internal problems within the organization.
internal.zh: 這份報告說明該組織內部的幾個問題。

interpret.en: Different readers may interpret the same story in different ways.
interpret.zh: 不同讀者可能用不同方式解讀同一個故事。

interrupt.en: Please do not interrupt while another student is presenting.
interrupt.zh: 其他同學報告時，請不要打斷。

interval.en: Students took a short break at regular interval points during practice.
interval.zh: 學生在練習過程中的固定間隔點短暫休息。

introduce.en: The teacher will introduce the new topic with a short video.
introduce.zh: 老師會用一段短影片介紹新主題。

invent.en: Engineers often invent new tools to solve practical problems.
invent.zh: 工程師常發明新工具來解決實際問題。

invest.en: The company plans to invest more money in clean energy.
invest.zh: 公司計畫投入更多資金於潔淨能源。

investigate.en: The science team will investigate why the plants grew differently.
investigate.zh: 科學小組將調查植物生長不同的原因。

involve.en: The project will involve students from three different classes.
involve.zh: 這項專題會有三個不同班級的學生參與。

issue.en: Water shortage is an important issue in many regions.
issue.zh: 缺水是許多地區的重要議題。

item.en: Each item on the checklist should be reviewed before submission.
item.zh: 提交前應檢查清單上的每一項。

journal.en: She recorded her observations in a science journal every day.
journal.zh: 她每天把觀察結果記錄在科學日誌裡。

judge.en: It is difficult to judge the result without enough evidence.
judge.zh: 沒有足夠證據時，很難判斷結果。

justify.en: Students must justify their answers with evidence from the passage.
justify.zh: 學生必須用文章中的證據說明答案的理由。

keen.en: He is keen to learn more about astronomy and space science.
keen.zh: 他很熱衷於學習更多天文與太空科學知識。

label.en: Please label each sample clearly before starting the experiment.
label.zh: 開始實驗前請清楚標示每個樣本。

labor.en: New machines reduced the amount of manual labor required.
labor.zh: 新機器減少了所需的人工勞動量。

lack.en: A lack of sleep can make concentration more difficult.
lack.zh: 睡眠不足會讓專注變得更困難。

landscape.en: The mountain landscape changed dramatically after the heavy rain.
landscape.zh: 大雨過後，山區景觀出現明顯變化。

language.en: Learning a new language requires regular practice and patience.
language.zh: 學習一種新語言需要規律練習與耐心。

launch.en: The school will launch a new reading program next month.
launch.zh: 學校下個月將推出新的閱讀計畫。

legal.en: The article explains several legal rules related to online privacy.
legal.zh: 這篇文章說明幾項與網路隱私有關的法律規定。

legend.en: The guide told us a local legend about the old bridge.
legend.zh: 導覽員告訴我們一個關於老橋的地方傳說。

leisure.en: Reading novels is a popular leisure activity among many students.
leisure.zh: 閱讀小說是許多學生喜愛的休閒活動。

limit.en: The teacher set a ten-minute limit for the discussion.
limit.zh: 老師為討論設定十分鐘的時間限制。

link.en: The study found a possible link between sleep and memory.
link.zh: 研究發現睡眠與記憶之間可能存在關聯。

literature.en: The course introduces students to modern literature from several countries.
literature.zh: 這門課介紹來自多個國家的現代文學作品。

locate.en: Use the map to locate the river near the city center.
locate.zh: 利用地圖找出市中心附近那條河的位置。

logical.en: A logical argument should connect evidence clearly to its conclusion.
logical.zh: 合乎邏輯的論點應清楚連結證據與結論。

maintain.en: Regular maintenance helps maintain the equipment in good condition.
maintain.zh: 定期保養有助於讓設備維持良好狀態。

majority.en: The majority of students supported the new library schedule.
majority.zh: 大多數學生支持新的圖書館開放時間。

manage.en: She learned to manage her time more effectively before exams.
manage.zh: 她學會在考前更有效管理時間。

manner.en: He answered the difficult question in a calm manner.
manner.zh: 他以冷靜的方式回答那個難題。

manufacture.en: The factory can manufacture thousands of parts each week.
manufacture.zh: 這座工廠每週可以製造數千個零件。

measure.en: Students measure the temperature at the same time each day.
measure.zh: 學生每天在同一時間測量溫度。

mechanism.en: The lesson explains the basic mechanism behind the water filter.
mechanism.zh: 這堂課說明濾水器背後的基本運作機制。

media.en: Social media can spread information very quickly among young people.
media.zh: 社群媒體可以在年輕人之間快速傳播資訊。

method.en: This method helps students organize complex information more clearly.
method.zh: 這種方法能幫助學生更清楚整理複雜資訊。

minor.en: The report found only a minor difference between the two groups.
minor.zh: 報告發現兩組之間只有小幅差異。

monitor.en: Researchers monitor the river level after periods of heavy rain.
monitor.zh: 研究人員在豪雨後監測河川水位。

motive.en: The story gradually reveals the main character's motive for leaving.
motive.zh: 故事逐漸揭示主角離開的動機。

multiple.en: The project uses multiple sources to compare different viewpoints.
multiple.zh: 這項專題使用多個來源比較不同觀點。
